interpretation: Composite OR signal (max-grad-at-step-25 OR loss-at-step-11) achieves held-out precision 0.79 (CI [0.58, 1.00]), recall 0.92, F1 0.84 on 671 LLaDA-family cells. Precision +0.11 over max-gradient alone, +-0.00 over loss-at-step-11 alone. Addresses NIM neurips_ac W7 critique (loss-at-step-11 beats max-grad at single step). The OR composite captures both the catastrophic-divergence cells (loss-at-step-11 spikes early) AND the late-trajectory routing-instability cells (max-grad maintains stable precision from step 25). Recommended deployment signal: log both, flag if EITHER exceeds threshold.
schema: Composite OR diagnostic: max-grad-at-step-25 OR loss-at-step-11. Bootstrap B=1000 80/20 splits.
